speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if your rash has a specific shape, such as being in a ring or having a red border with clear skin in the middle? Also, do you notice any blisters or scaling on the palms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT).

The combination of a chronic itchy rash on sun-exposed areas (face, upper body), sensory neuropathy in the palms, and your occupation involving farm work and livestock is highly suggestive of PCT, likely triggered by exposure to porphyrins in manure or liver issues. Have you noticed any blistering when your skin is exposed to sunlight, or any bruising on your hands?
